entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thanks for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling because I need to return a helmet I bought a little while ago. I just feel so bad about it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's just a preference, I suppose. I ordered the wrong color, and it just doesn't look right. The box is unopened, it's been sitting in my closet since it arrived. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really needed this money back for some other things.

I completely understand, and I appreciate your loyalty. No reason to feel bad, we want you to be happy with your gear. Getting the right color is important. Let me just pull up your order information. Can I get your full name, please?

Okay, Alex, thank you. I see your order for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered about 44 days ago. Let me just check our policy... and... good news! That item falls under our standard 10-day return policy. Since the box is unopened, this will be very straightforward. I can absolutely process that return for you.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie.

Of course. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label. And because I see you're one of our VIP members, I've also added a 15% discount coupon to your account. You can use that whenever you're ready to get that helmet in the color you really want.
Wow, you didn't have to do that. That is incredibly kind. You've made my day. Thank you again!
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Great. Have a wonderful day and ride safe.
